<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 211.0764, which likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈210.0691 Da. The formula C₁₄H₁₀O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 210.0680 Da, matching the observed mass within <2 ppm, making it the best candidate.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H10O2</final_answer>
